dossier.summary: Pinecrest Home Care sends nurses and aides to about 300 clients in their homes.

rows.label: Intake
rows.detail: Logs every new referral in the platform on the day it arrives.

rows.label: Care coordination
rows.detail: Schedules visits from the shared calendar instead of text messages.

rows.label: Billing
rows.detail: Submits claims from the visit record, with no re-keying.

rows.label: Q2 planning call
rows.detail: 30 minutes to agree the Q2 targets.

rows.label: Renewal proposal
rows.detail: Sent in writing before the renewal date.

data.headline: Pinecrest Home Care saved 268 hours in Q1, 26 percent more than in Q4, with 27 of 35 seats active.
data.usage_note: Active seats grew from 11 in October to 27 in March, and grew every month.
data.adoption_note: Intake has all 12 seats active. Care coordination has 9 of 14 and Billing 6 of 9.

wins.title: Hours saved by Intake
wins.body: Intake logs every new referral in the platform on the day it arrives. All 12 seats are active.

wins.title: Hours saved by Care coordination
wins.body: Care coordination schedules visits from the shared calendar instead of text messages. 9 of 14 seats are active.

wins.title: Hours saved by Billing
wins.body: Billing submits claims from the visit record, with no re-keying. 6 of 9 seats are active.

plan.what: Agree the Q2 targets on a 30-minute call.
Send the renewal proposal in writing.
Bring the 8 seats not yet in use into use: 5 in Care coordination and 3 in Billing.

data.next_note: The renewal date is 15 Apr, so the planning call on 9 Apr is the time to agree the Q2 targets and look at the proposal. Book a time that suits you.
